title: A review on the kinetic theory of oscillator chains

title: Rigorous Derivation of the Wave Kinetic Equation for full beta-FPUT System
model_match: Theorem 1.1 treats the equal-mass pure beta-FPUT four-wave system with beta=N^(-gamma), retaining resonant and nonresonant microscopic terms. It identifies the first kinetic increment of second-order correlations only through times N^(-epsilon) min(N,N^(4 gamma/3)), at most T_kin^(2/3). It is not the frozen random-mass cubic-leading three-wave model and does not give a full kinetic-window trajectory or late-window hitting theorem.
